name: DH-Robotics Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: DH-ROBOTICS was founded in 2016. It is a high-tech company focused on providing core components for intelligent industrial manufacturing. Specializing in precision motion control, the company has filled a gap in China's precision actuator sector. Its portfolio includes more than 200 products across multiple series, including servo electric grippers, voice-coil actuators, servo electric cylinders, dexterous hands and the iFM intelligent flexible motion system. It provides flexible, intelligent and low-carbon electric actuator products and solutions for the electronics, new energy and semiconductor industries, helping customers improve production efficiency and supporting intelligent manufacturing and sustainable development.
